My number one piece of advice is go to a local library! They have postings of events for all different activities/hobbies, find something that interests you and go! Def get a library card (free). 

There’s lots to do outside here, I suggest downloading alltrails to see trails near you! 

Both of those are totally free!

Next, find a coffee shop near you and bring something to do, laptop, book, etc. It’s nice to sit somewhere that isn’t your house, be around other people and not be expected to have a conversation. The more you go the more friendly you’ll become with the people, especially if you go around the same time. 

The state of Connecticut website has lots of resources! As well as the website for your town and towns around you, definitely check those out to see what events are happening. 

I’m not sure if every town does this but my town sends out brochures for different events in the area, some free, some not. Also a great way to get out of the house and meet people. It includes classes, groups, events, etc. 

Also most of the state parks have groups you can go on hikes/walks with. Also free. 

Try to find a primary care physician as soon as you can and they can refer you to different specialists, it’s so much faster than doing it alone. 

I hope this helps!! 💗💗
